question_or_proposition: For Pentachlorophenol at Outfall 001 under the Part I Section A effluent limits table, does the row—with N/A in all numeric limit columns and 'Report' paired with 1/Quarter grab sampling—establish only a monitoring and reporting obligation without any enforceable numeric effluent discharge limit, rather than an applicable numeric limit or a monitoring requirement that is not in effect?
required_context: Authorization paragraph limiting and monitoring discharges from Outfall 001 to the San Juan River during the permit term
Part I Section A effluent limits table column headers distinguishing mass-based limits, concentration limits, measurement frequency, and sample type
Pentachlorophenol target row: N/A across all limit columns, 'Report' in the concentration 7-day average column, 1/Quarter measurement frequency, Grab sample type
Adjacent pollutant rows sharing the same N/A-plus-Report-plus-1/Quarter pattern (e.g., Cadmium, 2,3,7,8-TCDD Dioxin, Aldrin)
source_locator: farmington/final_permit.pdf, Page 4, Section: part_i, Pentachlorophenol row
notes: Resolution determines whether reported Pentachlorophenol measurements are subject to numeric limit comparison (Purpose A), whether quarterly grab monitoring was required (Purpose B), and how absent or non-numeric Pentachlorophenol results should be classified when monitoring was or was not expected (Purpose C).
